records.title: LoopVAE: Recurrent Depth Across Scales for Visual Tokenization
records.reason: LoopVAE shares recurrent visual-autoencoder/tokenizer weights across scales for latent diffusion. Primary full text reports that parameter sharing stores 65.3% fewer parameters but uses 1.57x estimated MACs and 2.85x batch latency versus its local reference; the fixed recurrence is not an inference shortcut and is not evaluated as an LLM/VLM inference method. It is outside this batch's LLM inference/serving scope.
